description: The five-band Walraven VBLUW system, devised at the Leiden Southern Station for O- and B-type stars, with W and L in the far ultraviolet and Balmer-jump region.
facility_description: The General Catalogue of Photometric Data (GCPD, Mermilliod, Hauck & Mermilliod; now hosted at Masaryk University, Brno) compiles stellar photometry in more than 80 photometric systems together with system descriptions and filter transmission curves.
notes: NJM's curves for this instrument were taken from the SVO Filter Profile Service (GCPD group). Band Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables, cited via Wayback Machine captures because svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. Bands without the _ADPS suffix whose SVO ProfileReference is arXiv:1412.1474 are the Mann & von Braun (2015) revisions of the GCPD curves; _ADPS bands are the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems versions (Moro & Munari 2000; Fiorucci & Munari 2003), for which SVO's ProfileReference is the GCPD system page. Licence: GCPD publishes no explicit redistribution licence, only a citation request; classed 'attribution' on that basis. GCPD lists Walraven & Walraven (1960); the bibcode guess 1960BAN....15...67W failed check_refs. GCPD's curve page cites 'BAN 135, 23 (1960)' as printed.
